candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(_tos.length > 0) precondition so empty arrays no longer revert on entry and the function instead returns true.
The require statement on line 7 is weakened from requiring _tos.length > 0 to requiring true, so empty arrays no longer revert.
The transferFrom selector is changed to transfer(address,uint256), so the external call no longer invokes transferFrom.
The loop condition is changed from i<_tos.length to i<=_tos.length, causing one extra iteration and an out-of-bounds array access that reverts.
The loop increment is changed from i++ to i+=2, so only every other recipient is processed and insufficient transfers occur.
The loop-initializer value is changed from 0 to 1, skipping the first recipient in _tos.
The callee address in the external call is changed from caddress to a fresh zero address, making the call target a different contract.
The required success check on the external call is weakened from require(_s) to require(true), so failed calls no longer revert.
The success require(_s) after the external call is removed and reinserted before the external call, changing when the failed-call check is evaluated.
The function returns false instead of true after completing the transfers, so successful execution is observed as failure.
